nodes.Name: regSeq
nodes.DocComment:
Some save/restore operations can involve multiple registers in a single
instruction. For example, the LDP/STP instructions in ARM64:

	LDP 8(RSP), (R0, R1)
	STP (R0, R1), 8(RSP)

In these cases, a pair of registers (R0, R1) is used as a single argument.
